Download ExcelDownload PDF **27** Checkpoints **2** Sections As needed Site Engineer [IS 456:2000](https://infralens.in/code/IS-456-2000) Related [📐IS 456](https://infralens.in/code/IS-456) [✏️Minimum Ceiling Height Resi…](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/minimum-ceiling-height-residential) [📘Column Load Capacity Tables](https://infralens.in/handbook/column-capacity) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧rcc-design](https://infralens.in/tools/rcc-design) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | REG. CONCRETE POUR LOG - COLUMN DEFINITIONS | | COL-01 | S.No
Acceptance: Sequential numbering from 1 onwards | Serial number for each pour entry | | | COL-02 | Date
Acceptance: DD-MM-YYYY format | Date of concrete pour | | | COL-03 | Pour Time (Start-End)
Acceptance: HH:MM format, duration recorded | Start and end time of concrete placement | | | COL-04 | Element/Location
Acceptance: Clear identification with level/zone reference | Structural element being concreted (e.g., Slab, Beam, Column, Footing) | | | COL-05 | Drawing Ref
Acceptance: Drawing number and revision as per approved set | Reference drawing number for the element | | | COL-06 | Grade
Acceptance: As per design specification and drawing | Concrete grade (e.g., M25, M30, M40) | | | COL-07 | Mix Design Ref
Acceptance: Approved mix design reference matching grade and w/c ratio | Reference to approved mix design (ID/batch number) | | | COL-08 | Volume Planned (m³)
Acceptance: As per drawings and bill of quantities | Designed volume of concrete for the element | | | COL-09 | Volume Actual (m³)
Acceptance: Recorded from truck discharge tickets | Actual volume of concrete placed | | | COL-10 | Truck/Batch Count
Acceptance: Total count of delivery vehicles/batches | Number of transit mixer trucks or batches used | | | COL-11 | Slump Range (mm)
Acceptance: Slump 25-75 mm typical; verify against mix design specification | Measured slump as per IS 1199:1959 (Cone slump test) | | | COL-12 | Ambient Temp (°C)
Acceptance: 5-40°C normal; below 5°C or above 40°C requires special measures | Ambient air temperature during placement | | | COL-13 | Concrete Temp (°C)
Acceptance: 10-32°C typical; measured with thermometer at point of placement | Measured temperature of fresh concrete at placement | | | COL-14 | Cube Set IDs
Acceptance: Minimum 1 set per 30 m³; typically 6 cubes per set (3 for 7-day, 3 for 28-day) | Unique identifiers for all cube sets cast from this pour | | | COL-15 | W/C Ratio
Acceptance: As per approved mix design; reference value from batch ticket | Water-to-Cement ratio by weight | | | COL-16 | Admixture Used (type & dosage)
Acceptance: As per approved mix design; dosage in mL/100 kg cement or % by mass | Type and dosage of chemical admixtures (e.g., plasticizer, retarder, accelerator) | | | COL-17 | Pour Method (pump/crane/direct)
Acceptance: Pump (preferred), crane bucket, or direct from truck; free fall ≤1.5 m per IS 456 | Method of concrete placement into formwork | | | COL-18 | Vibration Method
Acceptance: Needle vibrator (immersion 5-15 sec per layer) or surface vibrator; frequency 50-100 Hz typical | Type and duration of vibration applied | | | COL-19 | Curing Start Date
Acceptance: Within 24 hours of placement (or earlier in hot/windy weather) | Date when curing commenced | | | COL-20 | Curing Method
Acceptance: Minimum 7 days for non-air-cooled concrete; 14 days for high strength or pozzolanic cement | Curing method (water spraying, wet burlap, curing compound, ponding) | | | COL-21 | Weather
Acceptance: Clear, Rainy, Windy, Hot, Cold; note if special measures taken | Weather conditions during placement and curing commencement | | | COL-22 | QC Engineer
Acceptance: Designated competent person present during entire pour operation | Name and signature of QC engineer supervising the pour | | | COL-23 | Remarks
Acceptance: Document any non-conformances or corrective actions taken | Any deviations, defects observed, or special notes | | | SUMMARY. MONTHLY SUMMARY | | SUM-01 | Total Pours (No.)
Acceptance: Cumulative from pour log | Count of all concrete pour events in the period | | | SUM-02 | Total Volume (m³)
Acceptance: Sum of all Volume Actual entries | Total actual volume of concrete placed in the period | | | SUM-03 | Average Slump (mm)
Acceptance: Mean of all recorded slump values | Average slump of all pours in the period | | | SUM-04 | Total Cubes Cast (No.)
Acceptance: Cumulative from all cube set IDs (typically 6 cubes per set) | Total count of cube specimens cast in the period | | REG. CONCRETE POUR LOG - COLUMN DEFINITIONS COL-01S.No Serial number for each pour entry (IS 456:2000) ✓ Sequential numbering from 1 onwards COL-02Date Date of concrete pour (IS 456:2000 Cl. 5.2) ✓ DD-MM-YYYY format COL-03Pour Time (Start-End) Start and end time of concrete placement (IS 456:2000 Cl. 13.2) ✓ HH:MM format, duration recorded COL-04Element/Location Structural element being concreted (e.g., Slab, Beam, Column, Footing) (IS 456:2000) ✓ Clear identification with level/zone reference COL-05Drawing Ref Reference drawing number for the element (IS 456:2000) ✓ Drawing number and revision as per approved set COL-06Grade Concrete grade (e.g., M25, M30, M40) (IS 456:2000 Cl. 5.2) ✓ As per design specification and drawing COL-07Mix Design Ref Reference to approved mix design (ID/batch number) (IS 10262:2009) ✓ Approved mix design reference matching grade and w/c ratio COL-08Volume Planned (m³) Designed volume of concrete for the element (IS 456:2000) ✓ As per drawings and bill of quantities COL-09Volume Actual (m³) Actual volume of concrete placed (IS 456:2000) ✓ Recorded from truck discharge tickets COL-10Truck/Batch Count Number of transit mixer trucks or batches used (IS 456:2000) ✓ Total count of delivery vehicles/batches COL-11Slump Range (mm) Measured slump as per IS 1199:1959 (Cone slump test) (IS 1199:1959, IS 456:2000 Cl. 5.2) ✓ Slump 25-75 mm typical; verify against mix design specification COL-12Ambient Temp (°C) Ambient air temperature during placement (IS 456:2000 Cl. 5.4) ✓ 5-40°C normal; below 5°C or above 40°C requires special measures COL-13Concrete Temp (°C) Measured temperature of fresh concrete at placement (IS 456:2000 Cl. 5.4) ✓ 10-32°C typical; measured with thermometer at point of placement COL-14Cube Set IDs Unique identifiers for all cube sets cast from this pour (IS 516:1959) ✓ Minimum 1 set per 30 m³; typically 6 cubes per set (3 for 7-day, 3 for 28-day) COL-15W/C Ratio Water-to-Cement ratio by weight (IS 456:2000 Cl. 5.2, IS 10262:2009) ✓ As per approved mix design; reference value from batch ticket COL-16Admixture Used (type & dosage) Type and dosage of chemical admixtures (e.g., plasticizer, retarder, accelerator) (IS 9103:1999) ✓ As per approved mix design; dosage in mL/100 kg cement or % by mass COL-17Pour Method (pump/crane/direct) Method of concrete placement into formwork (IS 456:2000 Cl. 13.2) ✓ Pump (preferred), crane bucket, or direct from truck; free fall ≤1.5 m per IS 456 COL-18Vibration Method Type and duration of vibration applied (IS 456:2000 Cl. 13.3) ✓ Needle vibrator (immersion 5-15 sec per layer) or surface vibrator; frequency 50-100 Hz typical COL-19Curing Start Date Date when curing commenced (IS 456:2000 Cl. 13.5) ✓ Within 24 hours of placement (or earlier in hot/windy weather) COL-20Curing Method Curing method (water spraying, wet burlap, curing compound, ponding) (IS 456:2000 Cl. 13.5) ✓ Minimum 7 days for non-air-cooled concrete; 14 days for high strength or pozzolanic cement COL-21Weather Weather conditions during placement and curing commencement (IS 456:2000 Cl. 5.4) ✓ Clear, Rainy, Windy, Hot, Cold; note if special measures taken COL-22QC Engineer Name and signature of QC engineer supervising the pour (IS 456:2000) ✓ Designated competent person present during entire pour operation COL-23Remarks Any deviations, defects observed, or special notes (IS 456:2000) ✓ Document any non-conformances or corrective actions taken SUMMARY. MONTHLY SUMMARY SUM-01Total Pours (No.) Count of all concrete pour events in the period (IS 456:2000) ✓ Cumulative from pour log SUM-02Total Volume (m³) Total actual volume of concrete placed in the period (IS 456:2000) ✓ Sum of all Volume Actual entries SUM-03Average Slump (mm) Average slump of all pours in the period (IS 1199:1959) ✓ Mean of all recorded slump values SUM-04Total Cubes Cast (No.) Total count of cube specimens cast in the period (IS 516:1959) ✓ Cumulative from all cube set IDs (typically 6 cubes per set) Inspection Sign-Off APPROVED APPROVED WITH CONDITIONS REJECTED Reviewed By (QC Engineer) Name / Sign / Date Signature Name / Sign / Date Approved By (Site In-charge/Supervisor) Name / Sign / Date Signature Name / Sign / Date ### More related 📐IS / IRC codes -
